description_en: Query the list of card information under a 5G high-speed cloud instance.
description_zh: 查询5G高速上云实例下的卡信息列表
kebab_example: aliyun cc5g list-cards --wireless-cloud-connector-id cc5g-xxxx --statuses Activated --iccids 89091231231219123 --ip-address 10.0.0.1 --lock true --online true --net-link-id cciot-xxxx --apn bjaliyun01s.5gbj.bjiot --next-token iou001238joojjaere --max-results 10 --iccid 8909123123121912 --msisdn 1441204374591 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCards

parameters.help_en: The ID of the 5G high-speed cloud instance
parameters.name: wireless_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en: The list of ICCIDs of the Internet of Things cards
parameters.name: iccids

parameters.help_en: The fixed IP address of the Internet of Things card
parameters.name: ip_address

parameters.help_en: The ID of the carrier APN
parameters.name: apn

parameters.help_en: The value returned from the previous page query. Do not specify this parameter for the first page query
parameters.help_zh: 上一页的查询返回的值，首页查询不传值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. The maximum value is 50. The default value is 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数，最大值为50，默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The prefix of the ICCID of the card. If the suffix contains characters, the characters are removed
parameters.help_zh: 卡的iccid的前缀，如果后缀包含字符会去除字符
parameters.name: iccid

parameters.help_en: The MSISDN of the Internet of Things SIM card
parameters.name: msisdn
